review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. No unresolved material DEC-001 or B/C scenario is present in this bundle, so an empty decision input and ready planning expectation are appropriate. Gold and preview release fingerprints match for repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. The original preparation snapshot's remaining items are distinguishable from the subsequently supplied frozen preview. This review uses only the supplied specification and evidence, without candidate outputs, execution, new human attestation, or independent digest recomputation; digest binding is accepted as Service-provided.
